newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-VAN ROOST SCORES ANOTHER UPSET AT OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-VAN ROOST SCORES ANOTHER UPSET AT OPEN.

text.p: Unseeded Belgian Dominique van Roost scored a second upset at the Australian Open on Monday, beating 15th seed Chanda Rubin in straight sets to book her first ever quarter-final berth in a grand slam event.

Van Roost, who beat world number two Arantxa Sanchez Vicario in the third round on Saturday, used spanking ground strokes and subtle drop shots to oust Rubin 7-5 6-4 on a baking centre court at Melbourne Park in one hour and 28 minutes.
Van Roost, who complained of a sore elbow in her match against Sanchez Vicario, again needed medical attention midway through her match on Monday.

A physiotherapist called to the court massaged and manipulated van Roost's back after the first game of the second set, but the injury did not appear to trouble the Belgian who took match point with an ace.
Van Roost, world ranked 43, will vie with either American 14th seed Mary Joe Fernandez or Patty Schnyder of Switzerland for a place in the semifinals.
